text: {"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"TO BE TOUGHENED UPTO 24-32 HRC."}],"comment":"The heat treatment is specified but the stage at which it applies (before or after machining) is not stated. Without this, the machinist cannot plan the process sequence, risking distortion of finished features. The designer should add whether toughening occurs before final machining or after roughing.","recommended_correction":"Update the heat_treatment field or note N1 to specify the manufacturing stage, e.g., 'TO BE TOUGHENED TO 24-32 HRC AFTER ROUGH MACHINING'."},{"rule_id":"TL-002","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D21","page":1,"quote":"20±0.02"}],"comment":"A tight-tolerance dimension (±0.02 mm) is given without a fit callout or any feature description identifying it as a mating surface such as a bearing seat or locating pin diameter. This leaves the machinist and inspector uncertain about the functional intent and how to verify the fit. The designer should identify the feature and add an appropriate ISO fit designation or clarify its function in a note.","recommended_correction":"Add an ISO fit callout (e.g., ⌀20 h6) to D21 if it is a shaft or bore fit, or add a note identifying the feature's mating function."}]}
